sources.title: 铁路旅客禁止、限制携带和托运物品目录
sources.excerpt: 标志清晰的充电宝、锂电池，单块额定能量不超过100Wh；日用刀具（刀刃长度超过60毫米）禁止随身携带但可以托运。自喷压力容器单体不超过150毫升，每种1件，累计不超过600毫升。

sources.title: 北京市轨道交通禁止携带物品目录（官方页面标注现行有效）
sources.excerpt: 菜刀、砍刀、美工刀等刀具及其他锐器、钝器；5个（含）以上打火机；包装上带有易燃、易爆等危险化学品标志或提示信息的日常用品类。

sources.title: 故宫博物院禁止携带物品目录
sources.excerpt: 锐器、钝器，如菜刀、砍刀等刀具；包装上带有易燃、易爆等危险化学品标志或提示信息的物品，如打火机、火柴，含酒精的饮品等。符合存包标准的可寄存。

sources.title: 天安门地区参观服务提示
sources.excerpt: 严禁携带危险物品、管制器具和违禁物品，禁止携带“低慢小”航空器、打火机等可能影响社会秩序和公共安全的物品。按预约日期和时段前往。

sources.title: TSA · Knives
sources.excerpt: Carry On Bags: No. Checked Bags: Yes. Except rounded-blade, blunt non-serrated butter knives or plastic cutlery. Sharp objects in checked bags should be sheathed or securely wrapped.

sources.title: TSA · Liquids Rule
sources.excerpt: A quart-sized bag of liquids, aerosols, gels, creams and pastes in carry-on baggage; containers 3.4 ounces (100 milliliters) or less per item. Exceptions and further screening may apply.

sources.title: FAA PackSafe · Lithium Batteries
sources.excerpt: Spare lithium batteries, including power banks, must be carried in carry-on baggage only. Lithium-ion batteries limited to 100Wh; larger batteries up to 160Wh require airline approval, up to two. Protect terminals. Damaged/recalled batteries likely to generate dangerous heat must not be carried.

sources.title: 民航局关于民航旅客携带“充电宝”乘机规定的公告
sources.excerpt: 充电宝严禁托运；不超过100Wh无需航司批准；超过100Wh但不超过160Wh需航司批准且不超过两个；超过160Wh或无法判定额定能量的严禁携带。飞行中不得使用。

sources.title: 民航局：禁止旅客携带无3C标识及被召回的充电宝乘坐境内航班
sources.excerpt: 自6月28日起禁止旅客携带没有3C标识、3C标识不清晰、被召回型号或批次的充电宝乘坐境内航班。

reason.en: Sharp knives are not permitted in TSA carry-on baggage. This category excludes blunt butter knives and plastic cutlery.
reason.zh: TSA禁止随身携带锐利刀具；本类别不包括钝头黄油刀和塑料餐具。

reason.en: A specialist or potentially controlled blade requires separate checks.
reason.zh: 专业或疑似管制刀具需单独核实。

reason.en: TSA permits checked knives when sheathed or securely wrapped. Destination/import rules are separate.
reason.zh: TSA允许妥善套封或包裹的刀具托运；目的地及入境要求需另行核实。

reason.en: Hazardous or special liquids need a substance-specific rule.
reason.zh: 危险或特殊液体需按具体成分核实。

reason.en: Ordinary liquids in containers over 100 mL do not meet the TSA carry-on liquid rule. Medical and other exceptions need separate screening.
reason.zh: 普通液体容器超过100毫升，不符合TSA随身液体要求；医疗等例外须另行核验。

reason.en: Each container must be 100 mL or less, and all liquids must fit in one quart-sized bag. Additional screening may apply.
reason.zh: 单体容器不超过100毫升，所有液体须装入一个夸脱大小袋中，可能需额外检查。

reason.en: Power banks and applicable spare lithium batteries cannot travel in checked baggage.
reason.zh: 充电宝及适用的备用锂电池不得放入托运行李。

reason.en: Rated energy exceeds 160 Wh.
reason.zh: 额定能量超过160Wh。

reason.en: A damaged battery needs carrier safety review; do not pack or ship it as ordinary baggage.
reason.zh: 损坏电池需承运方安全核验，不要按普通行李或包裹运输。

reason.en: Check the recall notice and carrier restrictions; no clearance is provided.
reason.zh: 需核对召回通知及承运方限制，本系统不提供放行结论。

reason.en: More than two batteries above 100 Wh exceed the larger-battery allowance.
reason.zh: 超过100Wh的电池多于两块，超过大容量电池数量限额。

reason.en: 100–160 Wh batteries require airline approval, maximum two. Carrier-specific restrictions still apply.
reason.zh: 超过100Wh且不超过160Wh需航司批准，最多两块；仍需核实航司附加要求。

reason.en: Rated energy cannot be confirmed from the label; request a clear label or operator assessment.
reason.zh: 无法从标签确认额定能量，请补拍清晰标签或请运营方判定。

reason.en: Up to 100 Wh under the checked conditions. Protect terminals, keep in the cabin, and confirm carrier-specific limits.
reason.zh: 已确认条件下不超过100Wh；保护接点、随身携带并核实航司附加限制。

reason.en: Power banks and applicable spare lithium batteries cannot travel in checked baggage.
reason.zh: 充电宝及适用的备用锂电池不得放入托运行李。

reason.en: Rated energy exceeds 160 Wh.
reason.zh: 额定能量超过160Wh。

reason.en: A damaged battery needs carrier safety review; do not pack or ship it as ordinary baggage.
reason.zh: 损坏电池需承运方安全核验，不要按普通行李或包裹运输。

reason.en: Check the recall notice and carrier restrictions; no clearance is provided.
reason.zh: 需核对召回通知及承运方限制，本系统不提供放行结论。

reason.en: More than two batteries above 100 Wh exceed the larger-battery allowance.
reason.zh: 超过100Wh的电池多于两块，超过大容量电池数量限额。

reason.en: 100–160 Wh batteries require airline approval, maximum two. Carrier-specific restrictions still apply.
reason.zh: 超过100Wh且不超过160Wh需航司批准，最多两块；仍需核实航司附加要求。

reason.en: Rated energy cannot be confirmed from the label; request a clear label or operator assessment.
reason.zh: 无法从标签确认额定能量，请补拍清晰标签或请运营方判定。

reason.en: A clear CCC mark is required for power banks on mainland domestic flights.
reason.zh: 中国境内航班要求充电宝具备清晰3C标识。

reason.en: Recalled power-bank models/batches are prohibited on mainland domestic flights.
reason.zh: 被召回型号或批次充电宝禁止携带乘坐境内航班。

reason.en: Up to 100 Wh under the checked conditions. Keep the power bank in the cabin, confirm carrier-specific limits, and do not use it during the flight.
reason.zh: 已确认条件下不超过100Wh；充电宝须随身携带，核实航司附加限制，并且飞行中不得使用。

reason.en: Railway carry-on batteries must not exceed 100 Wh per unit.
reason.zh: 铁路随身携带电池单块额定能量不得超过100Wh。

reason.en: Railway carry-on batteries must have clear markings.
reason.zh: 铁路要求充电宝及锂电池标志清晰。

reason.en: Damaged battery condition needs operator safety review.
reason.zh: 电池损坏状态需运营方另行安全核实。

reason.en: The clear-marking and per-unit 100 Wh railway conditions are met for this ordinary battery.
reason.zh: 该普通电池满足铁路标志清晰且单块不超过100Wh的条件。

reason.en: Do not infer controlled-weapon classification from blade length alone. Ask the operator.
reason.zh: 不能仅凭刀刃长度判定是否属于管制器具，请向运营方核实。

reason.en: Listed household knives with blades longer than 60 mm are prohibited in carry-on railway baggage. This does not itself classify them as controlled knives.
reason.zh: 目录内日用刀具刀刃超过60毫米禁止随身携带上火车，这不等同于认定为管制刀具。

reason.en: This ordinary blade does not exceed the listed 60 mm threshold; other sharp-tool categories and temporary restrictions still need operator confirmation.
reason.zh: 该普通刀刃未超过目录中的60毫米阈值，但其他锐器类别及临时限制仍需向运营方核实。

reason.en: Controlled or specialist classification requires official confirmation.
reason.zh: 管制或专业器具分类需官方核实。

reason.en: Ordinary knives in the listed category may be checked. Confirm baggage service availability and acceptance before arriving; parcel courier rules are separate.
reason.zh: 目录内普通刀具可按条件办理铁路托运，须提前确认业务及收运条件；快递规则另行核实。

reason.en: Industrial, pesticide or defence sprays need a substance-specific classification.
reason.zh: 工业、农药或防身喷剂需按具体类别核实。

reason.en: Pressurized toiletry containers may not exceed 150 mL each.
reason.zh: 自喷压力日用品单体容器不得超过150毫升。

reason.en: Flammable non-pressurized daily-use containers may not exceed 100 mL.
reason.zh: 含易燃成分的非自喷压力日用品单体容器不得超过100毫升。

reason.en: Only one of each restricted spray type is allowed.
reason.zh: 受限喷雾每种限带一件。

reason.en: Confirm the exact product class: pressurized daily-use containers up to 150 mL each, one of each type, 600 mL combined. Flammable non-pressurized daily products: 100 mL, one per type.
reason.zh: 需确认具体品类：自喷压力日用品单体150毫升以内、每种1件、累计600毫升；含易燃成分的非自喷日用品单体100毫升、每种1件。

reason.en: Alcoholic drinks above 70% ABV are prohibited.
reason.zh: 酒精体积含量超过70%的酒类饮品禁止携带。

reason.en: Packaging and label must be verified; unclear alcohol labels are prohibited.
reason.zh: 需核实包装及标签；标志不清晰的酒类饮品禁止携带。

reason.en: 24–70% ABV drinks must be sealed and clearly labelled, no more than 3,000 mL combined. Other alcohol products require separate checks.
reason.zh: 24%–70%酒类饮品须密封、标志清晰，累计不超过3000毫升；其他酒精产品需另查。

reason.en: At most two ordinary lighters may be carried on railways.
reason.zh: 铁路普通打火机最多携带2个。

reason.en: Torch lighters and fuel need a separate rule.
reason.zh: 喷枪类打火机或燃料需单独核实。

reason.en: At most two ordinary lighters; do not include lighter fuel. Temporary controls may differ.
reason.zh: 普通打火机不超过2个，不含打火机燃料，临时管制可能不同。

reason.en: Sharp knives/tools in this category are prohibited at this checkpoint; this is not a legal controlled-weapon determination.
reason.zh: 该类别锐利刀具或工具禁止带入此安检点；此结论不是管制器具法律认定。

reason.en: Daily-use products labelled flammable/explosive are prohibited here, regardless of a smaller travel size.
reason.zh: 包装标注易燃、易爆的日用品禁止带入此处，换小容量不消除该限制。

reason.en: No flame marking alone does not establish permission. Confirm the product contents with the venue.
reason.zh: 没有火苗标识不能单独证明可携带，需向场所核实成分及类别。

reason.en: Sharp knives/tools in this category are prohibited at this checkpoint; this is not a legal controlled-weapon determination.
reason.zh: 该类别锐利刀具或工具禁止带入此安检点；此结论不是管制器具法律认定。

reason.en: Daily-use products labelled flammable/explosive are prohibited here, regardless of a smaller travel size.
reason.zh: 包装标注易燃、易爆的日用品禁止带入此处，换小容量不消除该限制。

reason.en: No flame marking alone does not establish permission. Confirm the product contents with the venue.
reason.zh: 没有火苗标识不能单独证明可携带，需向场所核实成分及类别。

reason.en: Five or more lighters are prohibited on Beijing metro.
reason.zh: 北京地铁禁止携带5个及以上打火机。

reason.en: Special lighter/fuel classification needs confirmation.
reason.zh: 特殊打火机或燃料类别需另行核实。

reason.en: Fewer than five ordinary lighters under this directory; confirm temporary controls.
reason.zh: 此目录下普通打火机少于5个，仍需核实临时管制。

reason.en: Lighters are prohibited at this venue.
reason.zh: 该场所禁止携带打火机。

reason.en: Lighters are prohibited at this venue.
reason.zh: 该场所禁止携带打火机。

reason.en: The Palace Museum prohibited-items list includes alcoholic drinks.
reason.zh: 故宫禁止携带物品目录包含含酒精的饮品。

text.en: Use the Palace Museum's official booking channel and check the current passport and entry procedure. Palace admission and Tiananmen Square reservations are separate processes; verify any current exemption. Storage is only for items meeting the museum's acceptance conditions.
text.zh: 通过故宫官方渠道预约，并核实当前护照和入院流程。故宫与天安门广场预约是不同流程，是否有预约互认或豁免请查当日规定；仅符合故宫存包条件的物品可寄存。

text.en: Check the official Tiananmen Square reservation channel and attend at the booked time. Verify the current foreign-passport procedure and any event-day restrictions before visiting. This report does not confirm a reservation.
text.zh: 通过天安门广场官方预约渠道核实并按预约时段前往。出行前确认外籍护照办理流程及活动日临时管制；本报告不代表已预约。
